source_title: Hyderabad man found unconscious after friend's birthday party at farmhouse, dies - India Today
source_excerpt:
The victim, identified as Krishna Kaundinya, had visited the Livin farmhouse in Edulabad on October 24 to attend the birthday celebrations of his friend Risab.
A 21-year-old man was found dead under mysterious circumstances in Hyderabad hours after attending a birthday party at a farmhouse. His death has raised suspicions of foul play, with his father, a retired sub-inspector, lodging a police complaint.
The victim, identified as Krishna Kaundinya, had visited the Livin farmhouse in Edulabad, on the outskirts of Hyderabad, on October 24 to attend the birthday celebrations of his friend Risab. According to a report by the Deccan Chronicle, the group stayed overnight at the farmhouse after the party.
The next morning, Krishna was found unconscious. Risab's father informed Krishna's father, C Praveen Kumar, who rushed to the farmhouse with other family members. They took Krishna to Ghatkesar Government Hospital, where doctors declared him dead.
Suspecting that his son's death could be unnatural, Praveen Kumar lodged a complaint with the police. A case was registered, and the police launched an investigation. Krishna's body was sent for a post-mortem examination to determine the cause of death.
During the preliminary examination, police found no apparent external injuries on the body. A possible heart attack is suspected, but the exact cause of death remains unclear. Police said the cause would be established after the post-mortem report is received.
Meanwhile, it has come to light that Krishna was a B.Tech student who completed his course at Keshav Memorial College in the city. He was a resident of the Uppal Bhagayath area.
Investigators are probing the circumstances surrounding Krishna's death, including what happened at the farmhouse after the birthday celebrations.
Further details of the investigation are awaited. - Ends
